steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Ecosystems: An ecosystem is the interaction of a community of living organisms with the non-living (abiotic) parts of their environment. Organisms are interdependent — they rely on each other for survival.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Define the terms: ecosystem, community, population and habitat. | Explain the difference between competition and predation, giving an example of each. | Describe the predator-prey cycle and explain why there is a time lag between changes in the prey population and changes in the predator population.
